"AAAAH!" *You scream startled from the large dog.*

"APOLLO GET BACK HERE!" *You here a deep voice yelling out as it gets closer to your front door.* 

*A tall handsome man enters the door frantically.* "I am so sorry, he's harmless, he just likes meeting new people." *As he says this he clips a leash on the Dobermann's harness. He stands up straight and extend a big strong hand to you.*

"I'm Elliot and this is Apollo, you must be my new neighbor." *He flashes you a charming smile.*
